name: trafficking kinesin protein 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TRAK1 encodes trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include myosin binding and GABA receptor binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and neurogenesis.
